launches.body:
Vexo: An always listening AI bracelet that remembers and acts

Other wearables take notes. Vexo does the work.

Hey everyone! We're Haris, Farqaleet, and Vikram, the founders of Vexo.

**TL;DR:** Vexo is an always listening AI bracelet that remembers your conversations and gets things done.

Pre-order Vexo for \[$199\] at[ https://www.vexoai.com/checkout](https://www.vexoai.com/checkout).

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qDErdyS6gSE>

# Why we built Vexo

Most of our day happens away from a keyboard. The best context for AI is in what we say, and it disappears the moment we say it. So we built a bracelet that keeps it and acts on it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=128710&key=user_uploads/4000265/0f89b8c5-407c-4d41-bf43-27c870ef2ef1)

# "What did we talk about?"

You meet someone at an event and have a great conversation. A week later, you remember their idea but not their name.

Ask Vexo. It finds who you spoke to and what you discussed.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=128710&key=user_uploads/4000265/34922248-ace0-4319-89be-e6de62b50c18)

# It does the next step

Notetakers stop at the summary. Vexo starts there.

* Leave a client meeting, and the follow-up email is ready with the price and deadline you agreed on.
* Talk through a feature over lunch, and Claude has a first version ready for you to review.
* Plan a trip with friends, and ChatGPT already has the details.

**Nothing goes out without you.** You approve before Vexo sends a message, changes your calendar, or places an order.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=128710&key=user_uploads/4000265/866cffaa-997f-4abe-b881-5b1eb595a8bf)

# Always listening, and you're in control

* Press the button and Vexo stops listening. Press it again to resume.
* Vexo doesn't store audio.
* All transcripts are encrypted.
* Say "Hey Vexo, forget the past hour" and that transcript is deleted.

# The team

* **Farqaleet** built hardware and firmware for Tesla's energy products and Optimus.
* **Haris** built the OS for Tesla's energy products and Optimus, and the humanoid robot at K-Scale (W24).
* **Vikram** built software at Amazon and Shopify, and grew an iOS game to 6,000+ daily users in a week.

We designed the PCB, the enclosure, the firmware, the app, and the agents ourselves.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=128710&key=user_uploads/4000265/977f7568-7228-486a-9d00-8e97dae0c49f)
